mathematics.assertion_tested: The pinned 21-move certificate reconstructs identically in both supplied implementations, satisfies the stated finite local reply conditions, ends with no required cells, an envelope of 251 cells within a 17 by 17 square, and height 21; the supplied malformed-input and finite-board boundary tests reject their fixtures.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Z, exact integer pairs and finite sets
mathematics.conventions: Certificate orientation codes negate x for bit 2, negate y for bit 4, then swap for bit 1; inline pivots stay in the containing line coordinate frame. This code numbering differs from the challenge's equivalent enumeration of the eight orientations.
non_claims: This finite computation alone is not a proof of winning against every infinite-board continuation; that implication uses the combination lemma and induction.
It does not show 21 is optimal, search for a better strategy, or check the 25- and 35-move appendices.
Both evaluators are supplied by the same repository; their agreement is not a separate human or AI referee.
